name: mirage
text: Right now 118 bids are resting, $45.52 of your $251 cash (about 18%). The main reason is the new 'most money on one bet, similar bets together' cap, which is $3 in your settings. The engine says 198 more bids are waiting because the repeat guard holds them. Each one is a side, or something like it (the same game total at another line, the same team's spread and moneyline), that already has bets or bids up to the $3 limit. The cap counts your hand bets, the engine's bets and every resting bid together. So a few open bets on a game now block many bids on that game. The wallet target (90%) can't be reached while this cap is that tight. That is the cap working, not a fault. If you want more money working, raise the cap in Settings > Repeat and hedge guard. $8-10 would let roughly 2-3x as many bids stand. I haven't changed it, because you set $3 yourself and it is your risk limit. Tell me a number and I'll set it.
